title: Kissed Smoky Indian Shrimp Curry
description: A savory and crisp Indian dish featuring shrimp, dried cranberries, and a smoky flavor, perfect for a sick day, pescatarian-friendly and made in a wok.
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the smoked paprika, curry powder, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the shrimp and cook until they are pink and just cooked through, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the dried cranberries and cook for an additional minute.
Pour in the coconut milk and stir to combine, bringing the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and let the curry simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
